title: IFC Materials with Section Caps — Duplex
description: Loads the Duplex IFC model, applies procedural PBR materials per IFC type (each tagged with the appropriate ANSI/ISO hatch convention for body shading), and slices the model with a horizontal section plane. Caps render via the stencil-based cap pass and fill each cross-section with a flat capColor. Toggle between DetailedRender (hatched-Lambert body) and RealisticRender (PBR body) — caps stay filled in both.
